examples.subtitle: These photos look real but were created with AI.

reviews.name: Lauren Hayes
reviews.title: Director of Sales
reviews.review:
I was honestly pretty hesitant to try this. Most AI headshots I’ve seen look super filtered or just plain creepy. But I needed a new photo for a conference bio and didn’t have time to book a photographer.
I just uploaded a few random selfies from my camera roll, and was blown away. The results look professional but they actually still look like me, not a cartoon version. Already updated my LinkedIn and my Slack profile. If you hate getting your picture taken as much as I do, this is a lifesaver.

reviews.name: Rachel Foster
reviews.title: Founder & CEO
reviews.review:
Running a startup, I have zero bandwidth to coordinate a half-day shoot, hair, makeup, the whole thing. I was honestly skeptical that an AI could capture the right vibe. I wanted to look professional but not stiff, or like a stock photo model.
I’m actually shocked at how good these came out. It nailed the lighting and gave me that polished, approachable founder look I was going for. We used one for our Series A press announcement last week and nobody batted an eye. Huge time saver.

reviews.name: David Ross
reviews.title: Strategic Consultant
reviews.review:
Look, I avoid cameras at all costs. My LinkedIn photo was from 2018, and I knew I needed something current for a new consulting gig, but I just didn't want to deal with the hassle of a studio.
I uploaded a few random iPhone shots, and the AI cleaned everything up, fixed the lighting, and put me in a suit that looks tailored, not like a costume. I look professional but not 'fake' or airbrushed. Honestly, it saved me an afternoon and about $400. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Riccardo Moretti
reviews.title: Business Analyst
reviews.review:
I was extremely skeptical. I’ve tried a couple of other AI tools before and I always ended up looking like a weird video game character or just… off. But my company needed an updated bio pic for the new website and I really didn't have time to schedule a professional shoot.
I threw in some very average selfies and the results were honestly shocking. It didn't just paste my face onto a suit; the lighting and the expression looked completely natural. It’s the first time I’ve actually liked a "corporate" photo of myself in years. A total no-brainer if you're busy.

reviews.name: Ashley Davies
reviews.title: Marketing Manager
reviews.review:
As someone who has worked fully remote since 2020, I honestly don’t even own 'business attire' anymore. My daily uniform is leggings and a sweatshirt. But I was invited to speak on a virtual panel next month and realized my current LinkedIn picture was a cropped photo from a friend's wedding five years ago.
I was really dreading the idea of buying a blazer just for one headshot, so I tried this as a Hail Mary. I uploaded photos where I had zero makeup on and my hair was in a messy bun. The results are actually wild. It gave me a professional blowout and a sharp jacket that I definitely don't own. I look like the polished, 'together' version of myself that I aspire to be on Monday mornings.

reviews.name: Susan Clarke
reviews.title: Senior Project Manager
reviews.review:
I’ve been in project management for over 20 years, so I’ve seen plenty of tech fads come and go. I was honestly expecting this to be a gimmick—or worse, that it would airbrush me into looking like a 25-year-old, which would just feel ridiculous at my level.
I was pleasantly surprised by the nuance. It didn't erase my laugh lines or make me look 'plastic.' It just took my existing photos and gave them a polished, executive presence. It looks like me, just on a very good day with excellent lighting. It’s nice to finally have a LinkedIn photo that actually matches the seniority on my resume.

reviews.name: Robert Sterling
reviews.title: Managing Director
reviews.review:
In my position, maintaining a credible professional image is non-negotiable. I was initially skeptical that an algorithm could replicate the nuance of a studio portrait, but the results are undeniably impressive.
The tool generated a dignified, sharp image that was exactly what I required. For any executive looking to update their profile without the logistical downtime of a photoshoot, this is a pragmatic and high-quality solution.

reviews.name: Chris Bennett
reviews.title: HR Consultant
reviews.review:
I look at LinkedIn profiles for a living, so I can usually spot a bad AI headshot from a mile away. The glassy eyes, the weird smooth skin, these all give it away so easily. It’s becoming a huge pet peeve of mine. I only tried this tool because I needed a quick photo for a speaking engagement and my old headshot was from my first job out of college.
I was fully prepared to hate the results, but I have to eat my words. It actually kept the texture in my face and beard, rather than airbrushing me into a generic 'tech bro.' It looks professional, but approachable, which is the exact vibe you need in People Ops. If it can fool my eye, it’s good.

reviews.name: Giulia Bruno
reviews.title: Social Media Manager
reviews.review:
I’m currently pivoting from agency life to freelancing, and my imposter syndrome was going crazy because my LinkedIn photo was basically a cropped graduation picture from five years ago. I wanted a 'big girl' headshot, but I definitely didn't have $600 to drop on a branding shoot in the city.
I uploaded a selfie I took in my apartment with my cat literally visible in the background, just to see what would happen. The AI completely erased the mess and gave me this super clean, editorial look. It put me in a blazer that I wish I actually owned. It’s perfect. It makes me look successful and expensive, even though I’m currently working from my couch.

questions.q: How long does it take to train an AI model with my photos?
questions.a: With the new training model, training time is instant. Upload photos and you can already generate your photos.

questions.q: How long does it take to generate profile photos?

questions.q: What type of photos should I upload to create AI profile photos?
questions.a: We recommend uploading photos with high variety, a mix of close-up selfies and full-body photos in different places, angles, clothes and expressions. Don't upload photos with low variety, group photos, other people, sunglasses, hats, photos where your face is cut off or not visible.

questions.q: How much will the photos look like me?
questions.a: The similarity of the photos to you depends on the quality and variety of the photos you upload. The better and more varied your photos are, the more accurate the AI can be in understanding and representing your unique features. We continue to improve our models every day.

questions.q: Is my information secure? Do my photos and models remain private?
questions.a: Yes! The models you create and the photos you upload and take remain private. Your personal data, images and AI models are stored securely, and our system is designed to protect your information from unauthorized access.

questions.q: Who can use my AI profile photos?

faq.q: Do credits expire?
faq.a: No, credits do not expire. However, the AI model you trained expires after 30 days. You must use your credits within that time.

faq.q: What style of photos will I receive?
faq.a: Once your AI model is trained, you can select different styles from the Create tab. Each time you generate a photo in a selected style, you'll receive 4 different variants in that style. This allows you to experiment with various looks and choose your favorites.

faq.q: How long does it take to generate photos?
faq.a: The process happens in two steps: First, we train your AI model, which takes 15-30 minutes. After that, you can generate photos at any time, and each generation takes only 1-2 minutes to create 4 variants.

faq.q: Do you offer refunds?
faq.a: Yes, we offer a 100% refund guarantee if you are not satisfied with the quality of your photos. You can request a full refund within the first 7 days after your purchase.

faq.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a: We process all transactions using Stripe. You can pay using credit card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and more.

faq.q: How do I ensure the quality of my photos?
faq.a: Before training a model, we recommend reading our guide. This way you'll ensure that the generated photos are of the best possible quality.

faq.q: Who can use my photos and what about privacy?
faq.a: Your photos are exclusively yours. We prioritize your privacy and automatically delete all generated photos from our database after 30 days. The photos you generate are for your personal use and will not be shared or accessible to anyone else.

faq.q: What if the generated photos don't look like me?
faq.a: If you follow our instructions for selecting training images, you should get around 80% usable photos that look like you. We continuously update our models to improve accuracy. If you have doubts before starting, don't hesitate to contact us for guidance.

faq.q: Will the AI learn my unique characteristics?
faq.a: Yes, our AI is excellent at understanding and replicating what makes you unique. You can also adjust specific characteristics when generating images, such as whether you wear glasses or other distinctive features.

faq.q: Where can I use these photos?
faq.a: The photos are versatile and can be used anywhere you need a professional image of yourself. They're perfect for professional profile photos (LinkedIn, company websites), social media (Instagram, Facebook, Twitter) or personal branding. You can choose different dimensions like square format for profile photos or portrait mode for Instagram stories and other vertical designs.
